scenes.sub: Each request has a method: GET or POST (and PUT, DELETE…).
Data in the URL: ?name=Sam. Visible, small, bookmarkable. → doGet()
Data in the request body. Hidden, large, for forms/passwords. → doPost()

mnemonics.label: Points trick (difference)
mnemonics.html: URL Limited Bookmark vs Body Big Secure = GET: URL, limited size, bookmarkable · POST: body, large, more secure

code.title: Program: one servlet for GET and POST
lines: protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res)
protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res)

answer_html:
Definition

An HTTP servlet handles a browser request in methods like doGet() and doPost(), and sends back a response (HTML, status, headers).

Main methods

  • Request: getParameter(), getHeader(), getMethod().
  • Response: setContentType(), getWriter(), sendRedirect(), setStatus().
GETPOST
Data in URL (query string)Data in request body
Visible, less secureHidden, more secure
Limited sizeLarge data allowed
